description: Full visitor facts for one art event: dates, status, every venue with address and coordinates, ticket prices by tier with conditions, day-by-day opening hours, highlights, FAQ from the travel.art guide, other events in the same city at the same time, and where to eat / stay nearby when the guide has a map. Accepts an event id (for example art-basel-miami-2026) or an event name.
name: get_event
title: Get event details
